body.x: z-emotion (CEO Dong-soo Han) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.
z-emotion is a metaverse 3D digital style creation and simulation technology solution provider. The company launched a real-time virtual styling solution in August, 2022.

In CES 2023, they presented a real-time virtual styling solution and metaverse digital showroom, which are services that integrate their independently developed real-time 3D style simulation/rendering technology based on the metaverse. They provide a one-stop solution for ordinary users to create their avatars online or in the metaverse space, which enables them to try on the same quality clothing as the actual product in real time, to experiment with different styles, and even to purchase clothing for themselves. The key of this solution is a fast 3D engine that enables real-time application of virtual fitting technology.

A representative from z-emotion explained: “With the advancement of 3D computer graphics technology and the growth of metaverse-related services, there is a growing market demand for virtual styling solutions using digital human and avatar. As the convergence of the metaverse with digitalization of the existing fashion and apparel industries is also accelerating, the so-called Phygital clothing market is on the rise connecting physical clothing with virtual metaverse platforms.”

By implementing digital clothing that is close to the actual quality and related solutions, and then providing them to users, z-emotion allows for more immersive fashion styling in their avatars online or in the metaverse and even purchases of this clothing. The startup enhances metaverse content services while offering a new digital marketing tool for the existing fashion and apparel industry.

“With these outstanding features, we collaborated with Nike to launch a 3D styling campaign for customers who visited the Nike web and mobile pages. Since then, we have been working on projects that we'll launch in 2023 with partners from home and abroad.” The representative further explained, “We also plan to launch and provide a software tool in the first half of 2023 that will allow ordinary people to easily create 3D clothing and apply them to the metaverse service.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
